headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 10, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.25% compared to SPY's 14.08%. This results in an average alpha of 12.17%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 48.70%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 16.51%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly notable during a period characterized by macro uncertainty and market volatility. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
